description: This file implements a command-line interface command for discovering gateways on macOS within the OpenClaw project. It defines options parsing, output data structures, and the main asynchronous discovery function that manages the discovery process, handles JSON output, and displays results.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: Defines command-line options for the discovery command, with parsing logic from argument arrays.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: Encodable structure representing the discovery results, including nested 'Gateway' entries.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput.Gateway
classes.description: Represents a discovered gateway's details for JSON output.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to produce a 'DiscoveryOptions' instance.
